response.original_title: Sheep, Actually - A film about wool and a sheep named Cow
response.overview: In "Sheep, Actually" filmmaker Paul Wyatt asks "If you're going to work with wool, get to know how a sheep lives. Take a walk and meet the sheep." Wyatt does just that in this 64 minute UK documentary.
response.tagline: If you're going to work with wool, get to know how a sheep lives, take a walk and meet the sheep.
response.title: Sheep, Actually - A film about wool and a sheep named Cow
